name: BINARY HEARTS -WHITEOUT
source:
Set in a world where "N-Bots"—robots designed to aid people in their daily lives—have become commonplace, this story follows the protagonist and a sentient N-Bot named Shina as they embark on a journey together.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10800]Novelgame[/url]]

Takes place after END1 of BINARY HEARTS.
